scientific_integrity: Self-review only; no independent external validation or claimed authorship/provenance certification. The structural theorem is proved analytically; finite exact-rational tests only corroborate it.
scientific_limitations: Only unbalanced unweighted bicliques with \(2\le a<b\); homogeneous fidelity, excluding balanced bicliques and stars.
Balanced-branch exact optimization requires the explicit binomial coefficient test.
Equivalent unpublished or unindexed results are not ruled out.
title: A sharp bang–bang discounted hitting domination law on unbalanced complete bipartite graphs
